title: Earn AlFursan Reward Miles When You Fly with Saudia
desc: Discover the updated AlFursan Reward Miles earning rates for domestic and international flights. Maximize your travel value and earn more rewards with Saudia today.

To bring more value to you, our loyal Members, the AlFursan Program has updated its Reward Miles earning rates for domestic and international Saudia flights. Our Members will now capture more value per Saudia flight to earn Rewards with Saudia.

View the tables below to see how we’ve improved the earning rate on flights and where you can gain the most value from your next flight.

See how you can draw more value from the new Miles earning rates

We’re giving more value than ever with considerable changes in the Reward Miles earning rate when you fly with Saudia. Earn more Miles on your Saudia flights and use less Reward Miles when redeeming Rewards!

These changes to the AlFursan Program have overhauled the fundamental earning and redemption rates to make the path to redeeming Rewards faster for our Members.

For example, Members previously would need to take, on average, 18 domestic Saudia flights or 12.7 international Saudia flights to earn a Reward Ticket. However, as of 13 December 2022, those numbers, on average, have been reduced to 7.9 international Saudia flights or 8.8 domestic Saudia flights to earn a Reward Ticket.

Furthermore, to ensure you can draw the most value from your Miles, we have amended our three-year expiry period policy to ensure our Members can keep building towards great Rewards at their own pace! Our Reward Miles earning rate changes have been designed to complement the improvement in value achieved from lowering the redemption rate of Reward Miles. This means that you will be able to reach your Rewards faster than under the old AlFursan Program rules. This is true even for the saver fares where the number of Miles earned for a Saudia flight has been slightly reduced.

Terms and conditions:

  1. Saver brand is not eligible for upgrade by Miles.
  2. Tier Credits are applicable for upgrading a Membership Tier. Tier Credits are earned by Members after having travelled on Qualifying Flights during any one Calendar Year.
  3. Reward Miles are applicable for redemption for Rewards. Reward Miles are earned by Members after having travelled on Qualifying Flights or made Qualifying Purchases.
  4. Members on Silver (Elite) or Gold (Elite Plus) Membership Tiers will have opportunities to earn additional Reward Miles based on the base Miles of Qualifying Flights or travel class categories.
  5. Reward Miles shall be valid for a 2 year period from the date of the last qualifying activity. To see the current list of qualifying activity, please click here.
  6. To ensure that Tier Credits are accrued to the Membership, Members must ensure that the Membership number is quoted at the time of reservation or check‑in for Qualifying Flights.
  7. To ensure that Reward Miles are accrued to the Membership, Members must ensure that the Membership number is quoted: (1) at the time of reservation or check‑in for Qualifying Flights; or (2) at the time of paying for Qualifying Purchases.
  8. Reward Miles and Tier Credits accrue once per Qualifying Flight per Member based on the fare of the cabin class of the Qualifying Flight that was purchased regardless of the cabin class in which the Member flew.
  9. Members shall not earn Reward Miles or Tier Credits (Miles/Flight) through: (1) redeemed Reward Tickets; (2)Ticket in saver brand (3)free travel and non-scheduled or charter flight; or (4) non-public specially discounted travel tickets; (5) prize and promotional tickets; (6) industry and agent discounted tickets; (7) tickets without fares or class; (8) compensation tickets; (9) sponsorship or public relations tickets; or (10) group tickets. Any exceptions will be in Saudia sole discretion.
  10. Reward Miles are not redeemable for cash.
  11. Saudia reserves the right to deduct any ineligible Reward Miles or Tier Credits from any Membership if Saudia subsequently discovered that they were credited by mistake or as a result of any violation of these Terms and Conditions.
  12. Where Members are also members of other loyalty programs, Members may not claim services, benefits or rewards for the same transaction from multiple programs. Members must elect the preferred program in which they wish to earn the Miles.
  13. Members between the age of 2 and 11 years will earn Miles at 75% of the rate applicable for Members aged 12 years or over.

 

References to AlFursan Miles or Miles are to be construed as references to “Reward Miles” as defined in the AlFursan Program Terms and Conditions.
